items.title: After weeks of searching, focus shifts to recovery of missing workers and hydropower projects
items.summary: Kathmandu, October 2 More than a month after the Bhotekoshi flood swept through hydropower projects in Rasuwa and neighbouring districts, the search for missing workers and employees has entered a new phase. items.title: Bailey bridge installation begins along flood-damaged Galchhi-Betrawati road
items.summary: Kathmandu, October 2 Installation of a Bailey bridge has begun at Betrawati along the flood-damaged Galchhi-Betrawati road section in Rasuwa after an alternative temporary track was opened. According to Infrastructure Development Minister Sunil Lamsal, work on the foundations required for the Bailey bridge had already begun alongside construction of the temporary track. items.title: Floods drive 33 pregnant women to Kathmandu for childbirth
items.summary: Local maternity clinics and services remain disrupted in Rasuwa and Nuwakot since the August 26 floods. But many women cannot travel to Kathmandu because of damaged roads.
